blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are amines? Explain how they are classified, giving one aliphatic and one aromatic example of each class, and describe quaternary ammonium salts. (4 marks)
(Amines kya hain? In ki taqseem samjhayein, har class ki aik aliphatic aur aik aromatic misaal ke saath, aur quaternary ammonium salts bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amines ammonia ke organic derivatives hain jin mein alkyl ya aryl groups NH₃ ke aik, do ya teen H atoms ki jagah lete hain. IUPAC mein inhein alkanamines kehte hain. Kitne H atoms badle gaye, yahi taqseem ki buniyaad hai:

• Primary amines: –NH₂ group se aik alkyl ya aryl group jura hota hai. Misalein: ethanamine CH₃CH₂NH₂; phenyl amine (aniline) C₆H₅NH₂.
• Secondary amines: NH group se do alkyl ya aryl groups jure hote hain (N par aik H). Misalein: N-methylethanamine CH₃–NH–CH₂CH₃; diphenyl amine (C₆H₅)₂NH.
• Tertiary amines: aik hi nitrogen atom se teen alkyl ya aryl groups jure hote hain. Misalein: N,N-dimethylmethanamine (CH₃)₃N; triphenylamine (C₆H₅)₃N.

Quaternary ammonium salts: chaar groups wale nitrogen derivatives, maslan tetramethylammonium chloride (CH₃)₄N⁺Cl⁻.

Note: amine ki class nitrogen atom par branching se tay hoti hai, us se jure carbon atom se nahi; alcohols ya monohaloalkanes mein aisa nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: The number of hydrogen atoms replaced by alky or aryl groups provides a foundation

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the preparation of primary aliphatic amines by reduction of (i) alkanenitriles (ii) nitroalkanes (iii) alkanamides. Which method gives the best yield and why? (4 marks)
(Primary aliphatic amines ki tayyari reduction se bayan karein: (i) alkanenitriles (ii) nitroalkanes (iii) alkanamides. Kaun sa tareeqa behtareen yield deta hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Alkanenitriles ki reduction: propanenitrile ko H₂/Ni ya LiAlH₄ se reduce kar ke propan-1-amine banti hai.
CH₃CH₂C≡N + 4[H] —(LiAlH₄)→ CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂

(ii) Nitroalkanes ki reduction: nitroalkanes LiAlH₄ ki maujoodgi mein primary amines ban jate hain.
CH₃CH₂NO₂ + 3H₂ —(LiAlH₄)→ CH₃CH₂NH₂ + 2H₂O

(iii) Alkanamides ki reduction: alkanamides LiAlH₄ (phir H₂O/H⁺) se primary amines ban jati hain.
CH₃CONH₂ + 4[H] —(LiAlH₄)→ CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O

Behtareen yield: alkanamides ki reduction achhi yield deti hai kyun ke is reaction mein koi byproduct nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Primary amines are prepared by the reduction of alkanenitriles

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain how halogenoalkanes give amines with ammonia and with primary amines. How does the ratio of reactants control the product? (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke halogenoalkanes ammonia aur primary amines ke saath amines kaise banate hain. Reactants ki nisbat product ko kaise control karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Primary amines: halogenoalkanes ammonia ke saath nucleophilic substitution karte hain. Zyada ethanolic ammonia high pressure par li jati hai:
CH₃CH₂Br + NH₃ (zyada) —(ethanol, high pressure)→ CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HBr

Secondary amines (primary amines ki alkylation): halogenoalkane primary amine se ethanol mein pressure par react karta hai:
CH₃CH₂Br + CH₃NH₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ (N-methylethanamine) + HBr

Nisbat ka asar: bani hui amine halogenoalkane se aage bhi react kar sakti hai. NH₃ zyada ho to bara product primary amine hai; zyada ammonia secondary amines ya mixture banne se rokti hai. Halogenoalkane zyada ho to bara product tertiary amine hai.

book_ref.quote: Primary amines can be prepared by the nucleophilic substitution reactions of halogenoalkanes with ammonia

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the Hofmann reaction? Give its equations for ethanamide and benzamide and state its special feature. Also give the reduction of N-methylethanamide. (4 marks)
(Hofmann reaction kya hai? Ethanamide aur benzamide ke liye is ki equations dein aur khaas baat batayein. N-methylethanamide ki reduction bhi dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hofmann reaction: amide ko bromine aur sodium hydroxide ke saath react kara kar primary amine banai jati hai.
CH₃CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → CH₃NH₂ + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O
C₆H₅CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → C₆H₅NH₂ (phenylamine) + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O

Khaas baat: is reaction se shuru wali amide se aik carbon kam wali amine milti hai (C=O ka carbon Na₂CO₃ ban kar nikalta hai). Ethanamide (2 C) se methanamine (1 C); benzamide se phenylamine.

N-substituted amide ki reduction secondary amine deti hai:
CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ (N-methylethanamine) + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Primary alkanamine can also be prepared by the Hofmann reaction.

blocks.prompt:
5 Three amines P, Q and R have Kb = 4.4 × 10⁻⁴, 2.0 × 10⁻⁵ and 7.4 × 10⁻¹⁰ respectively. Taking pKb = –log Kb, calculate their pKb values, arrange them in order of basic strength and compare each with ammonia (pKb 4.75). Also find Kb of an amine S whose pKb is 3.50. (4 marks)
(Teen amines P, Q aur R ke Kb tarteeb se 4.4 × 10⁻⁴, 2.0 × 10⁻⁵ aur 7.4 × 10⁻¹⁰ hain. pKb = –log Kb le kar in ke pKb nikalein, basic taqat ki tarteeb banayein aur har aik ka ammonia (pKb 4.75) se muqabla karein. Aik amine S jis ka pKb 3.50 hai, us ka Kb bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har pKb –log Kb se nikalein; pKb jitna chhota (Kb jitna bara), base utni taqatwar. Ulta Kb = 10^(–pKb) se.

book_ref.quote: The Larger the Kb (or smaller the pKb), the stronger is the base

steps: Basic taqat ki tarteeb (sab se chhota pKb pehle): P > Q > R
Ammonia (4.75) ke muqable mein: P (3.36) aur Q (4.70) taqatwar bases hain; R (9.13) bohat kamzor hai, phenylamine (9.38) ki tarah jis ka lone pair phail jata hai
blocks.final_answer: pKb: P 3.36, Q 4.70, R 9.13; tarteeb P > Q > R; P aur Q ammonia se taqatwar, R kamzor; Kb(S) = 3.2 × 10⁻⁴

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain why amines are basic. Describe (i) their reaction with water (ii) salt formation with HCl, with equations, and (iii) why phenylamine is a much weaker base than ethanamine. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke amines basic kyun hain. Bayan karein: (i) paani se reaction (ii) HCl se salt banna, equations ke saath, aur (iii) phenylamine ethanamine se bohat kamzor base kyun hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Amines ki basicity nitrogen atom par lone pair electrons ki dastyabi par munhasir hai jo proton le sakta hai.

(i) Paani se: paani mein hal hone wali amines, ammonia ki tarah, paani se juzwi react kar ke OH⁻ ions banati hain, is liye mehlool halka alkaline hota hai.
NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (pKb 4.75)
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺ + OH⁻ (pKb 3.29)

(ii) HCl se: nitrogen atom apna electron pair proton ko de kar dative bond banata hai aur salt banta hai.
NH₃ + HCl → NH₄⁺Cl⁻
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HCl → CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺Cl⁻
(Istemal: lemon juice ka citric acid machhli ki boo wali trimethylamine se react karta hai.)

(iii) Ethanamine mein electron dene wala ethyl group N par electron density barhata hai. Phenylamine mein planar nitrogen ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo benzene ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai (Figure 24.1), is liye lone pair kam dastyab hai (pKb 9.38 bamuqabla 3.29).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia and ethanamine react with an acid to form salts due to their basic nature

blocks.prompt:
7 How are primary, secondary and tertiary aliphatic amines distinguished by nitrous acid? Give an equation and the observation for each. (4 marks)
(Nitrous acid se primary, secondary aur tertiary aliphatic amines mein farq kaise kiya jata hai? Har aik ki equation aur mushahida likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nitrous acid (nitric(III) acid) NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl se bana kar amine mein dala jata hai.

Primary amine: diazonium salt banata hai (diazotization), jo toot kar nitrogen gas deta hai.
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → CH₃CH₂N₂⁺Cl⁻ (ethane diazonium chloride) + 2H₂O
Mushahida: N₂ gas ke bulbulay.

Secondary amine: N-nitrosoamine banati hai.
CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + HNO₂ → CH₃CH₂N(NO)CH₃ + H₂O
Mushahida: peela tel jaisa maaya.

Tertiary amine: hal hone wala nitrite salt banati hai.
CH₃CH₂N(CH₃)₂ + HNO₂ → CH₃CH₂NH(CH₃)₂⁺ NO₂⁻
Mushahida: reaction ki koi nazar aane wali nishani nahi.

book_ref.quote: Primary, secondary and tertiary aliphatic amines are identified and distinguished

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the structure of phenylamine (hybridisation and delocalisation of the nitrogen lone pair) and explain its reaction with bromine water. (4 marks)
(Phenylamine ki structure (hybridisation aur nitrogen ke lone pair ka phailao) bayan karein aur bromine water se is ka reaction samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Structure: phenylamine ki ring ke carbons sp² hybridised hain. Nitrogen atom planar hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai (Figure 24.1). Yeh p orbital benzene ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai, is liye lone pair ring par phail jata hai (Figure 24.1). Is liye phenylamine do qisam ke reactions deti hai: benzene ring ki wajah se aur –NH₂ group ki wajah se.

Bromine water se reaction: amino group ortho-para directing hai, is liye electrophile o aur p positions par hamla karta hai. Is ke electrons ring ko kaafi reactive bana dete hain, khaas kar in positions par, is liye bromination benzene se tez hai aur dono ortho aur para positions aik hi reaction mein bhar jati hain:
C₆H₅NH₂ + 3Br₂ → 2,4,6-Br₃C₆H₂NH₂ (2,4,6-tribromophenylamine, safaid precipitate) + 3HBr

book_ref.quote: The presence of the amino group makes benzene ring fairly reactive

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the diazotization of phenylamine: preparation of nitrous acid, conditions and equation. Why are aryl diazonium salts more stable than alkyl ones? How is phenol obtained from the diazonium salt? (4 marks)
(Phenylamine ki diazotization bayan karein: nitrous acid ki tayyari, conditions aur equation. Aryl diazonium salts alkyl walon se zyada mustaqil kyun hain? Diazonium salt se phenol kaise milta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Nitrous acid ghair-mustaqil hai, is liye mauqa par (in situ) banaya jata hai: NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl

Diazotization: phenylamine, aik primary amine, nitrous acid aur HCl se 10 °C se kam (barf) par react kar ke phenyldiazonium chloride banati hai, jo –N⁺≡N group wala diazo compound hai:
C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O
Mixture 10 °C se kam rakha jata hai kyun ke diazonium salts ghair-mustaqil hain aur room temperature par bhi aasani se toot kar N₂ chhorte hain.

Mustaqili: alkyl diazonium salts har haal mein bohat ghair-mustaqil hain aur alag nahi kiye ja sakte. Aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi mustaqil hain kyun ke positive charge aromatic ring par phail jata hai. Yeh synthesis mein ahem intermediates hain.

Phenol: paani ke saath garam karne par diazonium salt ki hydrolysis hoti hai:
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O —(heat)→ C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl

book_ref.quote: Phenylamine being a primary amine reacts with nitrous acid to form phenyldiazonium salt

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a coupling reaction? Explain the coupling of benzenediazonium chloride with phenol, giving the conditions, the role of the diazonium ion and the steps of the mechanism. (4 marks)
(Coupling reaction kya hai? Benzenediazonium chloride ki phenol ke saath coupling samjhayein: conditions, diazonium ion ka kirdaar aur mechanism ke qadam.)
blocks.explanation:
Coupling reaction: aryl diazonium salt ka kisi taqatwar activated aromatic compound, jaise phenol ya amine, se reaction. Products mein –N=N– bond hota hai aur inhein azo compounds kehte hain.

Conditions: phenol ke saath coupling halke alkaline mehlool (NaOH) mein; aromatic amines ke saath halki acidic conditions mein.

Equation:
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅OH —(NaOH)→ C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄–OH (p-hydroxyazobenzene, narangi solid) + HCl

Mechanism:
1. Positive charge wala diazonium ion, C₆H₅–N⁺≡N, electrophile ka kaam karta hai.
2. Yeh phenol ki activated benzene ring par (–OH se) para position par hamla karta hai aur positive charge wala intermediate banta hai jis ke aik carbon par H aur –N=N–C₆H₅ dono hain.
3. Intermediate aik proton (–H⁺) kho deta hai, ring wapas ban jati hai aur p-hydroxyazobenzene, aik azo compound, banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Mechanism of the coupling of the diazonium ion with phenol

blocks.prompt:
11 Compare butter yellow and methyl orange as azo dyes: how each is formed, its structure and its use. What gives azo dyes their colour? (4 marks)
(Butter yellow aur methyl orange ka azo dyes ke taur par muqabla karein: har aik kaise banta hai, structure aur istemal. Azo dyes ko rang kis se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Dono diazonium salt ki N,N-dimethylphenylamine ke saath halki acidic conditions (ethanoic acid) mein coupling se bante hain:

Rang: azo group (Ph–N=N–Ph) chromophore hai jo gehre rang ka zimmedar hai; rang peele aur narangi se surkh, neele aur sabz tak hota hai, is par munhasir ke benzene rings par aur kaun se groups jure hain.

book_ref.quote: Coupling reaction can be used to form different types of azo dyes

rows: Product mein azo group N=N aur –SO₃Na group hai
Pehle khane mein istemal; ab carcinogenic hone ki wajah se mamnoo
Acid-base indicator ke taur par istemal

blocks.prompt:
12 What are alkanenitriles? Describe the acid and the alkaline hydrolysis of ethanenitrile with equations, and compare the two. (4 marks)
(Alkanenitriles kya hain? Ethanenitrile ki acid aur alkaline hydrolysis equations ke saath bayan karein aur dono ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alkanenitriles –CN functional group wale organic compounds hain, maslan ethanenitrile CH₃–CN aur propanenitrile CH₃CH₂–CN. In ka sab se ahem istemal dilute acid ya dilute alkali se hydrolysis kar ke carboxylic acids banana hai.

Acid hydrolysis: dilute HCl ya dilute H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karne par carboxylic acid banta hai:
CH₃CN(aq) + 2H₂O(l) + HCl(aq) → CH₃COOH(aq) + NH₄Cl(aq)

Alkaline hydrolysis: dilute NaOH ke saath garam karne par acid ka salt banta hai; dilute HCl se acidify karne par azad acid milta hai:
CH₃CN(aq) + H₂O(l) + NaOH(aq) → CH₃COONa(aq) + NH₃(g)
CH₃COONa(aq) + HCl(aq) → CH₃COOH(aq) + NaCl(aq)

book_ref.quote: However, the most important applications of alkanenitriles is their hydrolysis

rows: Azad carboxylic acid seedha banta hai
Sodium salt banta hai; acid ke liye acidify karein
Nitrogen NH₃ gas ban kar nikalti hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the preparation of amides from acyl chlorides with (i) ammonia (ii) primary amines. Why is an excess of ammonia or amine used? Explain the physical state and boiling points of amides. (4 marks)
(Acyl chlorides se amides ki tayyari bayan karein: (i) ammonia ke saath (ii) primary amines ke saath. Ammonia ya amine zyada kyun li jati hai? Amides ki physical haalat aur boiling points samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amides mein –CO–NH₂ group hota hai; carboxylic acids se banne ki wajah se inhein kabhi acid amides kehte hain.

(i) Acyl chlorides aur ammonia:
CH₃COCl + NH₃ → CH₃CONH₂ (ethanamide) + HCl
C₆H₅COCl + NH₃ → C₆H₅CONH₂ (benzamide) + HCl

(ii) Acyl chlorides aur primary amines (N-substituted amides):
CH₃COCl + CH₃CH₂NH₂ → CH₃CONHCH₂CH₃ (N-ethylethanamide) + HCl
CH₃COCl + C₆H₅NH₂ → CH₃CONHC₆H₅ (N-phenylethanamide) + HCl

Yeh reactions room temperature par hote hain aur HCl ke safaid dhuen nikalte hain. HCl ammonia ya amine ke doosre molecule se salt banati hai (NH₃ + HCl → NH₄⁺Cl⁻; RNH₂ + HCl → RNH₃⁺Cl⁻), is liye reaction mukammal karne ke liye zyada miqdaar li jati hai.

Physical khasiyatein: methanamide (liquid) ke ilawa tamam amides solid hain jin ke melting points sharp hain. Mazboot intermolecular hydrogen bonding ki wajah se boiling points kaafi buland hain. N-substituted amides mein alkyl substituents barhne se hydrogen bonding ki jagahein kam hoti hain aur melting aur boiling points kam ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: In the above two methods, all the reactions take place at room temperature

blocks.prompt:
14 Explain, using resonance, (i) why amides are less basic than aliphatic amines and form neutral solutions, (ii) why the C–N bond of an amide is shorter than that of an amine, and (iii) why amides are the least reactive acid derivatives. (4 marks)
(Resonance ki madad se samjhayein: (i) amides aliphatic amines se kam basic kyun hain aur neutral mehlool kyun banati hain, (ii) amide ka C–N bond amine se chhota kyun hai, aur (iii) amides sab se kam reactive acid derivatives kyun hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Amide mein resonance: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ki oxygen ke saath delocalise hota hai:
R–C(=O)–NH₂ ↔ R–C(–O⁻)=NH₂⁺

(i) Basicity: is phailao se nitrogen par electrons ki dastyabi kam hoti hai, is liye amides aliphatic amines se kam basic hain. Amines ke bar-aks amides paani mein neutral mehlool banati hain.

(ii) Bond ki lambai: resonance carbon aur nitrogen ke darmiyan double bond ki khasiyat lati hai, is liye amide ka C–N bond (132 pm) amine ke aam C–N single bond (147 pm) se chhota hai.

(iii) Reactivity: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl oxygen par phailne se carbonyl carbon ki electrophilic taqat (+δ charge) kam hoti hai. Is liye amides tamam acid derivatives mein sab se kam reactive hain; in ke reactions sust hain aur lambi der garam karna ya acid/base catalysts chahiye.

book_ref.quote: They exhibit resonance where the lone pair on nitrogen participates in delocalization

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the hydrolysis (acid and base catalysed) and the reduction of amides, with equations using ethanamide and benzamide. (4 marks)
(Amides ki hydrolysis (acid aur base catalysed) aur reduction bayan karein, ethanamide aur benzamide ki equations ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Amides ke reactions sust hain aur lambi der garam karna ya catalyst (acid ya base) chahiye.

1. Acid hydrolysis: unsubstituted amides carboxylic acid aur ammonium salt deti hain.
CH₃CONH₂ + H₂O + HCl → CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl

2. Base hydrolysis: products carboxylic acid ka salt aur ammonia hain; azad acid dilute HCl se milta hai.
CH₃CONH₂ + NaOH → CH₃COONa + NH₃
CH₃COONa + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl

3. Reduction: amides lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH₄, se dry ethoxyethane (ether) mein primary amines ban jati hain. Sirf C=O reduce hota hai; benzene ring waise hi rehti hai.
CH₃CONH₂ + 4[H] → CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O
C₆H₅CONH₂ + 4[H] → C₆H₅CH₂NH₂ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Some of them are given as under:

blocks.prompt:
16 What are α-amino acids? Give their general structure, explain the formation of the dipolar ion, and describe glycine and alanine. Which amino acids are chiral, and what are essential amino acids? (4 marks)
(α-Amino acids kya hain? In ki aam structure dein, dipolar ion banne ki wazahat karein, aur glycine aur alanine bayan karein. Kaun se amino acids chiral hain aur essential amino acids kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Amino acids mein basic amino group (–NH₂) aur acidic carboxylic acid group (–COOH) hota hai, is liye yeh amphoteric hain. Aam structure (2-aminocarboxylic acid, α-amino acid) H₂N–CH(R)–COOH hai; R woh hissa hai jo badalta hai.

Zwitter ion: proton usi molecule mein carboxyl group se amino group par chala jata hai aur positive aur negative sire wala dipolar ion banta hai: H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻. Dipolar structure ko internal salt bhi kehte hain.

Glycine (aminoethanoic acid), sab se saada amino acid: R = H, H₂N–CH₂–COOH.
Alanine (2-aminopropanoic acid): R = –CH₃, H₂N–CH(CH₃)–COOH.

Chirality: glycine ke ilawa tamam α-amino acids chiral hain.
Essential amino acids woh hain jo jism nahi bana sakta (khurak se lene parte hain); non-essential woh hain jo jism bana sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: An α-amino acid exists as a dipolar ion called Zwitter ion

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain the acidic and basic properties of amino acids. Which part of the zwitter ion is acidic and which is basic? Describe the forms present at different pH and define the isoelectric point. (4 marks)
(Amino acids ki acidic aur basic khasiyatein samjhayein. Zwitter ion ka kaun sa hissa acidic aur kaun sa basic hai? Mukhtalif pH par maujood shaklein bayan karein aur isoelectric point ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Amino acids amphoteric hain, magar zyada tar carboxylic acids se kam acidic aur zyada tar amines se kam basic hain.

Zwitter ion mein acidic hissa –NH₃⁺ hai (–COO⁻ nahi) aur basic hissa –COO⁻ hai (–NH₂ nahi):
H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₂N–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₃O⁺ (pKa ≈ 10)
H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COOH + OH⁻ (pKb ≈ 12)
RNH₃⁺ RCOOH se kamzor acid hai.

Paani ke mehlool mein shaklein (equilibrium mein):
H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COOH (cationic, kam pH) ⇌ H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ (dipolar ion, isoelectric pH) ⇌ H₂N–CH(R)–COO⁻ (anionic, zyada pH)
OH⁻ dalne se equilibrium daayein, H⁺ dalne se baayein jata hai.

Isoelectric point (pI): woh khaas pH jis par zwitter ion ka concentration sab se zyada ho, yani amino acid par koi majmui charge na ho. Har amino acid ka apna alag pI hota hai.

book_ref.quote: RNH₃⁺ is a weaker acid than RCOOH, as shown below:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa: pH kam (acid zyada) ho to amino acid proton le kar positive (cation) ban jata hai; pH zyada (base zyada) ho to proton de kar negative (anion) ban jata hai; beech mein pI par dono charges barabar hote hain (zwitter ion).

blocks.prompt:
18 A mixture of four amino acids W (pI 9.7), X (pI 7.5), Y (pI 6.0) and Z (pI 3.1) is separated by electrophoresis in a buffer of pH 6.0. Predict the charge and direction of movement of each, arrange the moving ones in order of speed, and state how the spots are located. (4 marks)
(Chaar amino acids W (pI 9.7), X (pI 7.5), Y (pI 6.0) aur Z (pI 3.1) ka mixture pH 6.0 ke buffer mein electrophoresis se alag kiya jata hai. Har aik ka charge aur chalne ki simt batayein, chalne walon ko raftaar ki tarteeb mein rakhein, aur batayein ke spots kaise dhoondhe jate hain.)
blocks.explanation: Har pI ka pH se muqabla karein: pI > pH yani positive (cathode ki taraf), pI < pH yani negative (anode ki taraf), pI = pH yani koi majmui charge nahi. |pI – pH| jitna bara, utni tez raftaar.

book_ref.quote: When an electric field is applied, the amino acids separate based on their different pI values

steps: W: pI 9.7 > pH 6.0, positive, cathode ki taraf; farq = 9.7 – 6.0 = 3.7
X: pI 7.5 > pH 6.0, positive, cathode ki taraf; farq = 7.5 – 6.0 = 1.5
Y: pI 6.0 = pH 6.0, koi majmui charge nahi (zwitter ion), shuru ki jagah par rehta hai
Z: pI 3.1 < pH 6.0, negative, anode ki taraf; farq = 6.0 – 3.1 = 2.9
Raftaar ki tarteeb (zyada farq, zyada tez): W (3.7) > Z (2.9) > X (1.5)
Spots be-rang hain; ninhydrin chhirak kar dhoondhe jate hain jo amino acids ke saath jamni (purple) product deta hai
blocks.final_answer: W aur X cathode ki taraf, Z anode ki taraf, Y apni jagah; raftaar W > Z > X; spots ninhydrin se (jamni)

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain the formation of a dipeptide from two amino acids. What is a peptide link, and why is the reaction a condensation? Define tripeptide and polypeptide, and find how many water molecules are lost in forming a chain of six amino acids. (4 marks)
(Do amino acids se dipeptide banna samjhayein. Peptide link kya hai aur yeh reaction condensation kyun hai? Tripeptide aur polypeptide ki definition likhein, aur chhe amino acids ki chain banne mein kitne paani ke molecules nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Amino acid molecules aapas mein react kar sakte hain: aik molecule ka acidic –COOH group doosre ke basic –NH₂ group se react karta hai. Do amino acids ka product dipeptide hai:
H₂N–CH(R)–COOH + H₂N–CH(R)–COOH → H₂N–CH(R)–CO–NH–CH(R)–COOH + H₂O

Peptide link: do amino acid molecules ke darmiyan amide bond (–CO–NH–) ko peptide bond ya peptide link kehte hain.

Condensation: reactant molecules ke jurte waqt aik chhota molecule, paani, nikal jata hai.

Tripeptide: teen amino acids ke condensation reaction se banne wala compound.
Polypeptide: bohat se amino acids ke condensation se banne wala compound.

Chhe amino acids ki chain: har peptide link par aik H₂O nikalta hai; 6 amino acids ko 6 – 1 = 5 links chahiye, is liye 5 paani ke molecules nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The acidic -COOH group in one amino acid molecule reacts with the basic-NH₂ group in another molecule
